status: CAR FACTORY MODEL - the DEFAULT player-visible Lada since v0.1.34 (owner decision 2026-11-22, ADR-009); the earlier procedural model is available with DEVELOPER > CAR FACTORY GLB CARS: OFF. The owner's visual review of the final look continues.
source: tools/car_factory/blender/build_lada_2106.py (one GLB, geometry variants RED = slot 1, WHITE = slot 2)
camber_note: Visual estimate from the concept sheets; cosmetic only, no physics.

red.note: RED sheet: exposed ITB engine, quad round lamps, chrome bumpers and trim, bolt-on overfenders, white 5-spoke dish wheels. Colour sampled from the sheet (#AE0E23 / #BF0A21).

white.note: WHITE sheet: clean bonnet with a raised centre panel, rectangular lamps, colour-keyed bumpers and skirts, rolled flares, grey-violet mesh wheels. The sheet's lavender tint is studio light; the paint is neutral pearl white.
white.paint_shader_note: White paint: lighter, neutral side shading (the default warm shade turned the pearl white beige).
